# Official Bellard QuickJS, statically embedded; quickjs-libc is not included.
set(HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Official QuickJS 2026-06-04 source directory")
set(HG_QUICKJS_ZIG "" CACHE FILEPATH "Zig 0.14.1 compiler for the MSVC-compatible QuickJS C core")
if(NOT EXISTS "${HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR to official QuickJS 2026-06-04 (see languages/hg_quickjs/README.md)")
endif()
set(stage "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source")
execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/prepare.py" "${HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR}" "${stage}" RESULT_VARIABLE result)
if(NOT result EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "QuickJS source preparation failed")
endif()
file(GLOB upstream_inputs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h" "${HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR}/*.c" "${HG_QUICKJS_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS prepare.py ${upstream_inputs})
file(GLOB core_headers "${stage}/*.h")
set(core quickjs dtoa libregexp libunicode cutils)
if(MSVC)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${HG_QUICKJS_ZIG}" OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "HGJS MSVC requires x64 and HG_QUICKJS_ZIG pointing to Zig 0.14.1")
    endif()
    execute_process(COMMAND "${HG_QUICKJS_ZIG}" version OUTPUT_VARIABLE zig_version OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
    if(NOT zig_version STREQUAL "0.14.1")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unreviewed Zig version ${zig_version}; expected 0.14.1")
    endif()
    foreach(name IN LISTS core)
        set(obj "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}.obj")
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${obj}"
            COMMAND "${HG_QUICKJS_ZIG}" cc -target x86_64-windows-msvc -std=gnu11 -O2 -fwrapv
                -D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS -DHG_QUICKJS_SINGLE_THREAD -D_GNU_SOURCE
                -DCONFIG_VERSION=\"2026-06-04\" -include stddef.h
                -I "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/win32" -c "${stage}/${name}.c" -o "${obj}"
            DEPENDS "${stage}/${name}.c" ${core_headers} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/win32/sys/time.h" VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND objects "${obj}")
    endforeach()
    add_library(hg_quickjs_runtime STATIC ${objects})
    set_target_properties(hg_quickjs_runtime PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE C)
else()
    foreach(name IN LISTS core)
        list(APPEND sources "${stage}/${name}.c")
    endforeach()
    add_library(hg_quickjs_runtime STATIC ${sources})
    target_compile_options(hg_quickjs_runtime PRIVATE -fwrapv -include stddef.h)
    target_compile_definitions(hg_quickjs_runtime PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE HG_QUICKJS_SINGLE_THREAD CONFIG_VERSION="2026-06-04")
    target_link_libraries(hg_quickjs_runtime PUBLIC m ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()
target_include_directories(hg_quickjs_runtime PUBLIC "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${stage}/include>" "$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CppSdkHeadersDestination}/extern/quickjs>")
set_target_properties(hg_quickjs_runtime PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON FOLDER "harfang/3rdparty/quickjs" PUBLIC_HEADER "${stage}/include/quickjs.h")
install_cppsdk_external_target(hg_quickjs_runtime quickjs)
install(FILES "${stage}/LICENSE" DESTINATION hgjs/licenses RENAME QuickJS.txt COMPONENT quickjs)
